');background-size:cover;background-position:center 58%;transform:translate3d(var(--parallax-x),var(--parallax-y),0) scale(var(--look-scale));filter:var(--look-filter);will-change:transform;transition:transform 1.05s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),filter 1s;z-index:-4}
.living-atmosphere{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 68% 25%,rgba(252,201,120,.15),transparent 33%),linear-gradient(0deg,#031014bb,transparent 38%,#0b10152c 85%);pointer-events:none;z-index:-3;transition:background .6s}.living-particles{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;z-index:-2}.living-grade{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:-1;mix-blend-mode:soft-light;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#09192a77,transparent 60%,#d9af7144);transition:background .6s}.living-vignette{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:inset 0 0 160px 32px #050a0c75;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#03070970 0%,transparent 29%,transparent 42%,#01080fcc 100%);z-index:0}
.living-upper{position:absolute;top:24px;left:clamp(20px,4.5vw,72px);right:clamp(20px,4.5vw,72px);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:10px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:.2em;color:#f5e1c4;z-index:3;text-shadow:0 2px 12px #101218}.living-live-dot{display:inline-block;width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--gold);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--gold);margin-right:10px}
.living-hotspot{position:absolute;z-index:4;border:0;background:transparent;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);padding:13px;text-shadow:0 2px 10px #000}.living-hotspot>span{width:18px;height:18px;border:1px solid #fff5d8;border-radius:50%;position:relative;display:block;background:#ffda9d38;box-shadow:0 0 0 8px #fce0af12,0 0 30px #ffdda15a;transition:transform .3s,background .3s}.living-hotspot>span:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff2cf}.living-hotspot:hover>span,.living-hotspot.selected>span{transform:scale(1.3);background:#f1c787ad}.living-hotspot em{font-style:normal;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:700;background:#07100f7d;padding:8px;border:1px solid #eee4d54a;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}.living-hotspot.selected em{border-color:#efcc95;color:#ffe1ac}
.living-caption{position:absolute;left:clamp(24px,6.3vw,100px);bottom:73px;max-width:min(750px,77%);z-index:3;pointer-events:none;text-shadow:0 3px 22px #01050b}.living-chapter{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.22em;color:#f1c993;font-weight:750;margin-bottom:15px}.living-caption h2{font:normal clamp(40px,6.3vw,98px)/.94 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.065em;margin:0 0 15px;color:#fff3df}.living-caption p{font-size:clamp(12px,1.32vw,16px);line-height:1.55;max-width:540px;color:#e9e8dc;margin:0}.living-corners{position:absolute;left:clamp(20px,4.5vw,72px);right:clamp(20px,4.5vw,72px);bottom:25px;border-top:1px solid #ffffff70;padding-top:11px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#e1d2b7;z-index:3}
.living-console{padding-top:37px;padding-bottom:26px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.65fr) minmax(300px,.75fr);gap:25px}.living-primary,.living-secondary{min-width:0}.living-primary{background:linear-gradient(155deg,#1e2424,#101617 60%);border:1px solid #ffffff20;padding:clamp(22px,2.5vw,36px)}.living-panel-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.living-panel-head h2{font:normal clamp(29px,3vw,43px) var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.04em;margin:12px 0 24px}.living-marker{font-size:10px;color:#baa78b;letter-spacing:.12em;white-space:nowrap}
.living-beat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.living-beat-grid button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;padding:20px 16px;min-height:136px;border:1px solid #e8dfcf30;background:#12191a;color:#eee2cc;transition:background .3s,border-color .3s}.living-beat-grid button:hover{background:#293031}.living-beat-grid button.selected{background:#c3986130;border-color:#f3cb8f}.living-beat-grid small{font-size:9px;color:#c4a57e;letter-spacing:.15em}.living-beat-grid strong{font:normal 26px var(--serif);margin:15px 0 7px}.living-beat-grid span{font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:#b0b5b4}
.living-choices-title{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin:36px 0 20px}.living-reset{background:transparent;border:0;color:#e5c29c;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px;font-size:11px}.living-camera-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:35px}.living-camera-control label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;color:#d8d4ca;font-size:12px;font-weight:650}.living-camera-control output{color:#edc18c}.living-camera-control input{display:block;width:100%;accent-color:#dfb67d;margin:19px 0 10px;cursor:pointer}.living-scale{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#929e9c}.living-label{font-size:11px;color:#d7d2c7;font-weight:650;margin:0 0 17px}.living-chip-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}.living-chip-row button,.living-sound-list button{background:#172020;color:#c3c8c3;border:1px solid #c9c6b33a;padding:11px 13px;font-size:11px}.living-chip-row button.selected,.living-sound-list button.selected{background:#b58c5d40;border-color:#e6bb82;color:#f8daac}.living-lesson{border-top:1px solid #ffffff2d;margin-top:35px;padding-top:22px}.living-lesson p{max-width:680px;color:#ded8cd;font:normal 18px/1.65 var(--serif);margin:11px 0 0}
.living-secondary{border:1px solid #ffffff20;background:#111719}.living-side-section{padding:25px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff20}.living-side-section:last-child{border-bottom:0}.living-side-section h3{font:normal 28px/1.1 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.02em;color:#f7e6cc;margin:14px 0 10px}.living-side-section p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;color:#b5bdba}.living-side-section p strong{color:#eee3d4}.living-side-section a{color:#e8b979;text-underline-offset:4px;font-size:12px}.living-sound-list{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:16px 0}.living-sound-list button{font-size:10px;padding:10px}.living-listen{width:100%;background:#d6ab75;color:#141513;border:0;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;font-size:10px;padding:14px}.living-side-section small{display:block;margin-top:8px;color:#849390;font-size:10px}.living-action-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px}.living-action-row button{border:1px solid #bbac9363;background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);color:#f0d8b5;padding:12px 13px;font-size:11px}.living-action-row button:hover{border-color:var(--gold)}.living-closeout{padding-top:35px;padding-bottom:95px}.living-closeout p{max-width:900px;font:normal clamp(21px,2.6vw,34px)/1.45 var(--serif);color:#dfd4c3}.living-closeout button{margin-top:16px}
@media(min-width:1500px){.living-viewport{height:700px}}
@media(max-width:950px){.living-console{grid-template-columns:1fr}.living-secondary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.living-side-section:last-child{grid-column:span 2;border-top:1px solid #ffffff24}.living-archive-label{min-width:unset}.living-art{background-position:60% 55%}}
@media(max-width:650px){.living-intro{padding-top:33px;padding-bottom:24px}.living-intro .bigtitle{font-size:58px}.living-intro .lead{font-size:13px;line-height:1.65}.living-archive-label{display:none}.living-viewport{min-height:495px;height:64svh;max-height:650px}.living-art{background-position:67% center}.living-upper{top:17px;left:17px;right:17px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.07em}.living-upper span:last-child{font-size:8px}.living-hotspot em{font-size:8px;padding:5px}.living-hotspot{gap:5px;padding:6px}.living-hotspot>span{width:15px;height:15px}.living-hotspot[data-scene-beat="0"]{left:20%!important;top:52%!important}.living-hotspot[data-scene-beat="1"]{left:56%!important;top:31%!important}.living-hotspot[data-scene-beat="2"]{left:76%!important;top:64%!important}.living-caption{bottom:61px;left:22px;max-width:88%}.living-caption h2{font-size:clamp(42px,10.5vw,60px)}.living-caption p{font-size:12px}.living-chapter{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.15em}.living-corners{left:17px;right:17px;bottom:15px;font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.04em}.living-corners span:last-child{max-width:135px;text-align:right}.living-console{padding-top:16px;gap:12px}.living-primary{padding:22px 16px}.living-panel-head h2{font-size:31px}.living-marker{font-size:8px}.living-beat-grid{gap:7px}.living-beat-grid button{padding:13px 9px;min-height:122px}.living-beat-grid small{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:0}.living-beat-grid strong{font-size:20px;margin:12px 0 8px}.living-beat-grid span{font-size:10px}.living-camera-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:26px}.living-choices-title{margin-top:30px}.living-secondary{display:block}.living-side-section:last-child{grid-column:auto}.living-closeout{padding-bottom:60px}.living-closeout p{font-size:24px}}
@media(max-width:360px){.living-upper{flex-wrap:wrap}.living-hotspot em{font-size:7px}.living-beat-grid strong{font-size:18px}.living-beat-grid span{font-size:9px}.living-viewport{min-height:460px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.living-art,.living-hotspot>span{transition:none!important}.living-live-dot{box-shadow:none}}

/* V5 art direction / bring the cinematic world into the first viewport */
#sceneView{position:relative}
#sceneView .living-intro{position:absolute;z-index:5;top:0;left:0;right:0;padding-top:49px;padding-bottom:0;pointer-events:none}
#sceneView .living-intro .bigtitle{font-size:clamp(62px,7.5vw,108px);text-shadow:0 4px 38px #000b10b0;max-width:840px}
#sceneView .living-intro .lead{font-size:14px;max-width:600px;color:#ece7da;text-shadow:0 3px 19px #02090bd8}
#sceneView .living-intro .eyebrow{text-shadow:0 2px 15px #061015}
#sceneView .living-archive-label{color:#e9c89c;text-shadow:0 3px 15px #000}
#sceneView .living-viewport{height:calc(100svh - 136px);min-height:670px;max-height:850px}
#sceneView .living-viewport:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#060d15a6 0%,#0a121a2b 34%,transparent 65%);pointer-events:none;z-index:1}
#sceneView .living-hotspot[data-scene-beat="0"]{top:53%!important}
#sceneView .living-upper>span:first-child{display:none}
@media(max-width:950px){#sceneView .living-intro{padding-top:30px}#sceneView .living-intro .bigtitle{font-size:clamp(56px,7vw,85px)}}
@media(max-width:650px){
 #sceneView .living-intro{padding:28px 20px 0}
 #sceneView .living-intro .bigtitle{font-size:clamp(54px,13vw,70px);line-height:.93;margin:12px 0 12px}
 #sceneView .living-intro .lead{max-width:315px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.01em}
 #sceneView .living-intro .eyebrow{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.17em}
 #sceneView .living-viewport{min-height:630px;height:calc(100svh - 112px);max-height:800px}
 #sceneView .living-viewport:after{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#030a11cf,transparent 59%)}
 #sceneView .living-upper{top:auto;bottom:15px;font-size:7px;z-index:5}
 #sceneView .living-upper span:last-child{display:none}
 #sceneView .living-hotspot{top:55%!important}
 #sceneView .living-hotspot[data-scene-beat="0"]{left:18%!important}
 #sceneView .living-hotspot[data-scene-beat="1"]{left:51%!important;top:43%!important}
 #sceneView .living-hotspot[data-scene-beat="2"]{left:83%!important;top:57%!important}
 #sceneView .living-hotspot em{display:none}
 #sceneView .living-hotspot>span{width:23px;height:23px}
 #sceneView .living-caption{bottom:65px;left:20px;right:20px;max-width:none}
 #sceneView .living-caption h2{font-size:clamp(45px,11vw,57px);max-width:350px;margin-bottom:10px}
 #sceneView .living-caption p{font-size:12px;max-width:310px}
 #sceneView .living-corners{display:none}
}
@media(max-width:360px){#sceneView .living-intro .bigtitle{font-size:50px}#sceneView .living-intro .lead{font-size:10px}#sceneView .living-caption h2{font-size:45px}}
